name: Arunaya Organics Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2010, Arunaya Organics Limited is engaged in the manufacturing and exporting of specialty dyes and intermediates.[1]
keyPoints:
Product Portfolio[1]
a) Acid Dyes:
Applied in acidic solutions on protein fibers like wool, silk, and nylon, forming strong ionic bonds for vibrant, durable colors.

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
